chapters.label: Slow, then boom
chapters.text: The Etihad, in the rain. Doku strolls toward the box. Then boom, a burst of speed! He shapes to shoot, slips it to Rodri, gets it back, and curls it low into the far corner!

chapters.label: Change of pace
chapters.text: Watch again. Slow, slow, then a sudden change of pace, and a quick one-two!

chapters.label: The Doku show
chapters.text: The keeper cannot reach it. Doku set up four more goals. City won six to one!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: dribble slowly so the defender relaxes, then explode past him at full speed!
